title: Intent Envelope
description: A declaration of what an AI agent is for, written before the agent runs and enforced outside the model at every tool call.

intent_envelope.description: Version of this specification the envelope is written against.

id.description: Stable identifier for this envelope, unique within the deploying organization.

revision.description: Incremented whenever the envelope changes. Enforcement points may refuse an unknown revision.

purpose.description: What this agent is for, in terms a reviewer who owns the workflow can approve or reject.

principal.description: Who the agent acts as, and on whose behalf.

agent_identity.description: The agent's own identity. Never a shared or human credential.

on_behalf_of.description: The human or team whose authority the agent is borrowing.

tools.description: Which tools the agent may call. A call to anything not allowed is refused.

deny.description: Tools refused even if a future change widens the allow list. Deny always wins.

data.description: Which data the agent may reach, expressed in whatever addressing the deployment uses.

recipients.description: Who the agent may send anything to. Absent means nobody.

allow.description: Addresses or domain patterns the agent may contact.

limits.description: Budget the run may consume before it is stopped.

escalate.description: Actions that are inside the envelope but must pause for a named human.

when.description: The condition that triggers escalation, in the deployment's own expression syntax.

to.description: A named human or rota. Never an unattended address.

expires.description: After this instant the envelope is invalid and every call is refused.

on_no_response.description: What happens when an escalation is never answered. Only deny is safe.

constraints.description: Argument constraints the enforcement point checks before the call is made.
